snippet.title: Quest Master | Ice Dungeon Update | Available Now!
snippet.description:
Play Quest Master! ► http://apo.gg/QuestMaster
Step into the ultimate Zelda-like Dungeon Maker with Quest Master, now featuring the chilling new Ice Temple Update! Freeze enemies, obstacles, and even liquids with frosty mechanics that add slippery slopes, brain-teasing puzzles, and icy challenges. Design dungeons with frozen items that require creative solutions to thaw, and craft treacherous paths with temporary frozen water.

With an intuitive drag-and-drop system, create intricate dungeons filled with traps, monsters, and puzzles. Upload your masterpieces for others to conquer, or explore over 3,000+ community-made dungeons already available. Quest Master is in Steam Early Access now, with the biggest update yet—1.0—coming in 2025! Unleash your creativity and save the kingdom of Aetheria from a magical evil across six stunning biomes. The adventure is yours to shape!
